description: Monthly and yearly cost of one or more Azure VM sizes for pay as you go, reservations and savings plans, with the break-even hours per month for each commitment. Use it to compare sizes or regions.

hours_per_month.description: Runtime hours per month. Default 730 (always on).

os.description: Operating system for pay-as-you-go prices. Default linux.

region.description: Azure region, e.g. westeurope or "West Europe". Omit to use each size's cheapest region.

sizes.description: One to five VM sizes to price, e.g. ["Standard_D4s_v5", "Standard_D4as_v6"].

name: estimate_vm_cost
title: Estimate Azure VM cost
